== Description ==
Displays a standardized infobox for all characters in Erenshor - both hostile enemies and friendly NPCs.

Most fields are auto-generated from the game database by [[User:WoWBot|WoWBot]]
and should not be manually edited. Fields marked '''Manual''' can be added or corrected by editors.

The '''Interactive Map''' row links to the [https://erenshor.compendiums.org/map Interactive World Map] and shows all known spawn
locations for the character.

== Syntax ==
<pre>
{{Character
|name=
|image=
|imagecaption=
|type=
|faction=
|factionChange=
|zones=
|coordinates=
|location=
|spawnchance=
|respawn=
|guaranteeddrops=
|droprates=
|level=
|experience=
|health=
|mana=
|ac=
|strength=
|endurance=
|dexterity=
|agility=
|intelligence=
|wisdom=
|charisma=
|magic=
|poison=
|elemental=
|void=
|spells=
|levelmodmin=
|levelmodmax=
|levelvariancemin=
|levelvariancemax=
|xpmultiplier=
}}
</pre>

== Parameters ==
{| class="wikitable"
! Parameter !! Source !! Description
|-
| <code>name</code> || Auto || Character display name. Also drives the interactive map search link.
|-
| <code>image</code> || Auto || Image in <code><nowiki>[[File:Name.png|thumb]]</nowiki></code> format.
|-
| <code>imagecaption</code> || '''Manual''' || Optional caption below the character image.
|-
| <code>type</code> || Auto (manual override accepted) || Character classification: <code>NPC</code>, <code>Boss</code>, <code>Rare</code>, or <code>Enemy</code>. Controls page category and map link prefix.
|-
| <code>faction</code> || Auto || Faction wiki link.
|-
| <code>factionChange</code> || Auto || Reputation changes granted to the player on kill.
|-
| <code>class</code> || '''Manual''' || Character class (used by Simulated Player pages).
|-
| <code>zones</code> || Auto || Zone wiki links where this character spawns.
|-
| <code>coordinates</code> || Auto || Game coordinates (<code>X x Y x Z</code>). Only shown for single-location characters.
|-
| <code>location</code> || '''Manual''' || Plain-text description of where to find the character, such as <code>Near the zone-in</code> or <code>By the bank in Port Azure</code>. Never overwritten by the bot.
|-
| <code>spawnchance</code> || Auto || Spawn chance percentage. Only shown for rare/unique characters.
|-
| <code>respawn</code> || Auto || Base respawn time.
|-
| <code>guaranteeddrops</code> || Auto || Items with 100% drop rate (shown only when two or more exist).
|-
| <code>droprates</code> || Auto || All loot drops sorted by probability.
|-
| <code>level</code> || Auto || Base character level.
|-
| <code>experience</code> || '''Manual''' || Base XP range. Not auto-generated.
|-
| <code>health</code> || Auto || Calculated maximum HP.
|-
| <code>ac</code> || Auto || Calculated armor class.
|-
| <code>magic</code> || Auto || Magic resistance range (e.g. <code>10-30</code>).
|-
| <code>poison</code> || Auto || Poison resistance range.
|-
| <code>elemental</code> || Auto || Elemental resistance range.
|-
| <code>void</code> || Auto || Void resistance range.
|-
| <code>spells</code> || Auto || Spells used by this character.
|}

== Example ==
<pre>
{{Character
|name=Aetherfiend
|image=[[File:Aetherfiend.png|thumb]]
|imagecaption=
|type=Enemy
|faction=[[The Followers of Evil]]

|zones=[[Loomingwood Forest]]
|coordinates=
|spawnchance=
|respawn=5 minutes
|guaranteeddrops=
|droprates={{ItemLink|Citrine Stone}} (57.4%)<br>{{ItemLink|Star Stone}} (57.4%)<br>{{ItemLink|Aether's Blessing}} (20.5%)<br>{{ItemLink|Aetherial Hood}} (12.1%)<br>{{ItemLink|Rune of Silkengrass}} (5.9%)<ref>If the player is already holding {{ItemLink|Rune of Silkengrass}} in their inventory, another will not drop.</ref><br>{{ItemLink|Blueprint: Loomingwood Market}} (0.4%)<br>{{ItemLink|Blueprint: Loomingwood Shrine}} (0.4%)
|level=27
|levelmodmin=0
|levelmodmax=0
|levelvariancemin=-1
|levelvariancemax=1
|xpmultiplier=1.0
|health=50050
|mana=0
|ac=405
|strength=550
|endurance=550
|dexterity=550
|agility=550
|intelligence=550
|wisdom=550
|charisma=550
|magic=14-32
|poison=14-32
|elemental=14-32
|void=14-32
|spells=
}}
</pre>
